title: Cut a subject out of a flat background
description: Makes the background transparent: its colour is read off the border (or set with key=#rrggbb) and removed from the border inwards, so the same colour inside the subject stays (mode=key removes it everywhere). Edge pixels get partial alpha without the background's tint, the result is trimmed to the subject, and a JSON sidecar records its anchor (bottom centre) and where it sat in the source. No AI model runs; it needs a plain background.
